description: A shell script that checks the authentication status for Claude Code and OpenClaw services, providing output in full, JSON, or simple modes. It assesses credentials and tokens stored locally, fetches status via commands and JSON parsing, and provides status summaries with color-coded output.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches the status JSON from the 'openclaw models status' command.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates status based on expiration timestamp, returning 'MISSING', 'EXPIRED', 'EXPIRING', or 'OK'.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts the expiration timestamp for Claude CLI OAuth profiles from the status JSON.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts the maximum expiration timestamp for any 'anthropic' OAuth profile.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Returns the profile ID of the 'anthropic' OAuth profile with the latest expiration date.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of 'anthropic' API keys available in the status JSON.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the expiration status of Claude Code credentials, either via JSON or local credential file.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the expiration status of OpenClaw authentication, via JSON or local profile file.
